_meta.usage: full landline number in national form (9 digits): 02-623-4567, (04) 812-3456; drop a leading +972. A bare code is not accepted, so other countries' codes don't match
_meta.note: Only five geographic codes, and a code's area does not follow district borders: each key lists every district it reaches, including districts it covers only in part. Checked on 2026-10-14 against OpenStreetMap: the 1,700 Israeli landline numbers in phone tags were placed in the six district polygons and counted by code; codes seen only on chain head offices and call centres were not counted as coverage. Numbers in the Judea and Samaria Area (02, 03, 08, 09) have no district in the admin table.
_meta.miss_note: not an Israeli geographic code: 05x mobile, 07x VoIP/non-geographic, 1-700/1-800 numbers
